name: v8-r3-aim-gain
description: Cell R-3 (plan section 9, N 43): persistence gain on the aim (S-2 option A): g_k = theta sum_j (1 - theta)^j rho_k(j) from rank autocorrelation only, theta .05, clipped to [.05, 1] as coded (fit_composition_weights.py aim_gain). Ruling E-27: the gains multiply the member weights of the parent's composition: on an R-1 parent (fit --composition ew-theme-std-v1) the tier weights inside each theme, renormalised inside the theme so each theme keeps 1/T, member cap 1/(2T) after (ew-theme-std-aim-v1, composition_rules.py; the IC runner's theme_standardise block is unchanged); on an ew-theme-v1 parent ew-theme-aim-v1, which Ruling E-27a makes the same rule on the parent's equal member weights (gains renormalised inside each theme, each theme 1/T, member cap 1/(2T) after; composition_rules.ew_theme_aim, the code ew-theme-std-aim-v1 runs; a weights file of schema v1, no theme block). The fit flag maps the parent's composition to that rule. Downstream outputs renamed (fit, card, w, nav, monitor); the u pass is the parent's. Acceptance: dSR > 0 AND mechanics AND net Sharpe at 2x NAV not lower (capacity curve, carried from B0c) AND turnover lower.
